subject: Trial convergence plan & exec clearance
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@acmeclinical.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: POC scope & timeline

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good conversation and I appreciate the demo walkthrough. A few items we discussed and my notes so we have alignment before a POC: 

- Goals: Reduce triage time for claims review by surfacing context and suggested next-steps; improve average handle time for clinical operations by ~25%.
- Data: We'll provide de-identified claims + a sample of clinical notes (SFTP access) for a 3-week POC.
- Users: 5 frontline reviewers + 2 supervisors for evaluation.
- Timing: Target start window = Oct 4 week; POC length = 3 weeks + 1 week buffer for data onboarding.

Can you send a short POC scope doc with proposed success criteria, owners, and a recommended exec readout cadence? Also want to understand what Redwood needs from procurement/legal to keep the contract path tight (SOW -> PO -> signature).

Attachments: none on my side yet — I can share a sample data manifest once we confirm the start window.

Appreciate a crisp list of owners and the single point of contact for the exec readout.

Best,
Emily
Emily Carter
Head of Clinical Ops, Acme Clinical
emily.carter@acmeclinical.com
+1 415-555-0134

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@acmeclinical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmeclinical.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: POC scope & timeline

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear notes, that matches our side. Attached is a short POC scope (nimble_poc_scope.xlsx) with proposed success criteria and owner map. High-level summary below: 

POC overview (3 weeks + 1 onboarding buffer)
- Audience: 5 reviewers / 2 supervisors (as discussed)
- Success criteria (one or more must be met for go):
  1) Reduce average triage time by >=20% on the test set;
  2) Achieve >=85% precision on suggested next-steps for the supervisor cohort;
  3) Positive qualitative score (>=4/5) from at least 60% of end users in the usability survey.
- Ownership:
  - Data & access: Acme (Emily / Tom)
  - Redwood POC lead: Priyom Das (will own runtime/config & daily checks)
  - Onsite support / onboarding: Marissa Cole (technical onboarding and eval harness)
  - Exec readout owner: Emily (customer-side) / Priyom (Redwood-side)
- Proposed timeline:
  - Data handoff & SFTP credentials: by Sep 29
  - Onboarding & smoke tests: Oct 4–6
  - POC run: Oct 7–27
  - Internal readout / decision window: week of Nov 1 (exec slot)

Contract / procurement notes:
- For speed, we recommend an SOW + limited data processing addendum (we can start with our standard POC SOW).
- If procurement needs an expedited path, we can provide a short summary of technical controls + redwood_sla_summary.pdf (attached) to send to procurement/legal.

Next steps / asks for Acme: please confirm the start week (Oct 4) and the SFTP contact. Once confirmed I will circulate the exec readout proposal and a 30-min exec clearance agenda for your leadership.

Attachments: nimble_poc_scope.xlsx (POC scope + checklist)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Acme POC — exec clearance & decision path (need quick alignment)

Team — looping you in so we have a tight path to an exec readout and a clean contract close if the POC meets criteria. Emily confirmed the timeline above and is aligned to target Oct 4 start. Key asks:

1) Exec clearance slot: we should propose a 30-minute executive readout week of Nov 1. Need 1x sales exec + 1x engineering lead.
2) Decision gate (go/no-go): Recommend a binary gate based on the success criteria in the attached scope. If at least one quantitative metric is met AND the qualitative survey meets threshold, escalate to exec for approval.
3) Contract path: Our standard motion — SOW for POC, then a follow-on commercial SOW + PO. If Acme pushes for an enterprise SLA now, we should offer the SLA summary and give procurement the contact in Legal to speed review (Lauren, can you confirm availability for a quick intake?).
4) Pricing ask: Marissa — can you propose an estimated POC credit/discount to include in the readout? Sales wants a number to present if the exec asks for a concession.

Proposed internal owners:
- Sales exec: Sean Gallagher (exec engagement)
- POC lead: Priyom Das (runtime/config & daily checks)
- Onboarding & eval harness: Marissa Cole
- Legal intake / procurement liaison: Lauren Bishop

I'll draft a short 30-min exec agenda with timeboxed metrics and a single recommended ask (go/no-go + recommended commercial motion) and send to Emily for scheduling. Please reply with availability windows for an executive on the week of Nov 1 (preferably Tue/Wed morning PT).

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@acmeclinical.com>
